delegated.label: Delegated
delegated.description: Handed off to an external library manager

not_found.label: Not found
not_found.description: This track wasn't found on Soulseek or YouTube. Availability changes over time, so a retry later may find it.

import_rejected.label: Import rejected
import_rejected.description: The file downloaded but its details didn't match the requested track, so it wasn't added. A retry re-imports the same file only.

wrong_file.label: Wrong file
wrong_file.description: The downloaded file didn't match the requested track, so it was removed. A retry searches again for a better match.

p2p_failed.label: Connection dropped
p2p_failed.description: The connection to the Soulseek peer dropped before the download finished. A retry may work better.

download_failed.label: Download failed
download_failed.description: The track was found, but the download didn't finish. The source may have blocked the request or the connection stalled. A retry may help.

other.label: Failed
other.description: The download failed for an unexpected reason. A retry may help.
